# 2005 Toyota HiAce

- Creator: ActsOfDoge
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/2005-toyota-hiace-c8a13f7fa53e45a2b151339d402f3392
- Download: original GLB archive supplied through Sketchfab
- Licence shown at download: Sketchfab Free Standard
- Downloaded: 2026-11-05

The untouched provider files are retained in this folder. Prepared materials,
colliders, wheel rigs and gameplay prefabs belong outside `ThirdParty`.

Initial inspection found four separate wheel meshes, separate bumper and grille
meshes, eleven materials and ten embedded textures. The main body and interior
parts are mostly combined and require visual inspection before cabin gameplay is
approved.
